posts.text: Following up on @Nishit_Shah2 ’s point about bulk deposits. Went through the Q2 FY27 investor presentation and press release (both filed 23 Oct) and the deposit side has moved the same way again. Headline numbers look good: deposits +18% YoY to ₹46,889 Cr, advances +22%, PAT +14% to ₹183 Cr. But look at what the deposit growth is made of. CASA was ₹8,394 Cr in Q2 FY26 and is ₹8,889 Cr now, only +6%. Term deposits went from ₹31,257 Cr to ₹38,000 Cr, +22%.
